title: Jim B Probable NDE 8940/8193
content:
8940 I was alone at the time the heart attack hit. I was in a parking lot putting groceries in my car when I fell and fractured my skull on the pavement. I don't know how long I stayed that way. A man called 911 and the bagboy at the grocery store came over and saw what was happening. He went into the store to get the Pharmacist and both performed CPR on m. The rescue squad got there and had to defibrillate me twice. Then the ambulance came and difibrillated me four more times on the way to the hospital, which was 2-1/2 miles away. My hospital records show that I coded four times in the first 24 hours. I was given 48 hours of hypothermic therapy and was in a coma for 6 more days. I was given 4 stents in my right coronary artery and a pacemaker. I woke from the coma with no idea what had happened, my sister was there to help with that. I have no memory of the 6 weeks prior to the heart attack and waking in the hospital with my sister. The only memory I have is an all-encompassing warm light and a peaceful serene sense that everything was as it should be. I have no fear of death now.

No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I have had cardiac rehabilitation and continue to work on my physical recovery. Yes It took me a while to comprehend what had happened to me as far as what actually happened compared to 'memories when I was in a coma.' For instance, when my sister told me I had a massive heart attack I was relieved and happy that I had not had a stroke. The Doctor was very concerned that I would stroke out while in the coma. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience.
